entries.description: The brahmins and householders of Nagaravinda heard
entries.subject: The

spans.text: Assosuṁ kho nagaravindeyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā: The brahmins and householders of Nagaravinda heard, “samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito kosalesu cārikaṁ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṁ nagaravindaṁ anuppatto.

entries.description: the Kosalans has arrived at Nagaravinda
entries.subject: the Kosalans

spans.text: “It seems the ascetic Gotama—a Sakyan, gone forth from a Sakyan family—while wandering in the land of the Kosalans has arrived at Nagaravinda, together with a large Saṅgha of mendicants.

‘That Blessed One is perfected, a fully awakened Buddha, accomplished in knowledge and conduct, holy, knower of the world, supreme guide for those fit for training, teacher of gods and humans, awakened, blessed.’
